# Parallel Arabic

> Parallel Arabic teaches Egyptian Arabic, Levantine Arabic, Moroccan Darija, and Modern Standard Arabic (Fusha) through interactive lessons, native-audio stories, vocabulary spaced-repetition, handwriting practice, and an AI conversation tutor with real-time pronunciation feedback. The app is built around dialects spoken in real life — not just textbook MSA — and lets learners generate practice material around words they actually want to use.

## About

- [About Parallel Arabic](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/about): How the app teaches Arabic across four dialects and what makes it different from Duolingo and traditional textbook courses.
- [FAQ](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/faq): Common questions about supported dialects, beginner-friendliness, mobile availability, and how the AI features work.
- [Support](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/support): How to reach the team for help.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/privacy): How user data is handled.

## Learn an Arabic Dialect

- [Egyptian Arabic](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/egyptian-arabic): Stories, vocabulary, lessons, and speaking practice in the most-spoken Arabic dialect, used across Egypt and widely understood in film and music.
- [Levantine Arabic](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/levantine): Vocabulary and writing practice for the dialect spoken in Syria, Lebanon, Jordan, and Palestine.
- [Moroccan Darija](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/darija): Vocabulary and writing practice for the dialect of Morocco — the dialect least intelligible to other Arabic speakers and hardest to find learning resources for.
- [Modern Standard Arabic (Fusha)](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/fusha): The formal written and broadcast form of Arabic used across the Arab world and in religious contexts.

## Core Learning Features

- [Arabic Alphabet](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/alphabet): Learn to read and write the Arabic script from scratch, with native audio for every letter.
- [Lessons](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/lessons): Structured learning paths organized by module and topic, available in all four dialects.
- [Vocabulary](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/vocabulary): Browsable word lists with audio, transliterations, English translations, and the ability to save words to a personal wordbank.
- [Stories](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/stories): Short stories with synchronized native audio, word-by-word interlinear translations, and the ability to tap any word for a definition in context.
- [Sentence Practice](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/sentences): Type or reorder Arabic sentences with real-time per-character correctness feedback and an on-screen Arabic keyboard.
- [Speaking Practice](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/speak): Speak Arabic out loud and get character-level pronunciation feedback comparing what you said to the target.
- [AI Tutor](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/tutor): Free-form conversation with an AI tutor in your target dialect, with corrections, vocabulary explanations, and audio replies.
- [Interactive Videos](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/videos): YouTube videos for Arabic learners with synchronized transcripts, translations, and tap-for-definition.
- [Arabic Games](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/learn/game): A hub of Arabic word and grammar games in Egyptian, Levantine, Darija and Fusha. Every game has two free rounds, no account needed.
  - [Arabic Word Scramble](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/learn/game/word-scramble): Unscramble an Arabic word from its letters and watch them join as they are placed.
  - [Arabic Odd One Out](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/learn/game/odd-one-out): Four Arabic words, one doesn't belong, by meaning, gender, word type or shared root, with an explanation.
  - [Spot the Mistake](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/learn/game/spot-the-mistake): Arabic grammar game: find the one wrong word in each sentence and see the correction.
  - [Arabic Sentence Scramble](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/learn/game/sentence-scramble): Rebuild Arabic sentences from scrambled words, with fresh sentences at the learner's level.
  - [Arabic Vocabulary Quiz](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/learn/game/quiz): Multiple choice, listening comprehension and speaking rounds, built fresh at the learner's level.
- [Verb Conjugation Practice](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/conjugations): Drill Arabic verb conjugation across past, present, future, and imperative in any dialect.
- [Egyptian Arabic Conjugation Tables](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/egyptian-arabic/conjugations): Full conjugation tables for 72 common Egyptian Arabic verbs, with transliteration and English for every form.
- [Egyptian Arabic Phrases](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/egyptian-arabic/phrases): How to say hello, thank you, happy birthday and other everyday phrases in Egyptian Arabic, with tashkeel, transliteration, audio and the forms for a man, a woman or a group. Also available for [Levantine](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/levantine/phrases), [Darija](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/darija/phrases) and [Fusha](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/fusha/phrases).
- [Egyptian Arabic Words](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/egyptian-arabic/word): Common Egyptian Arabic vocabulary, each word with audio and real example sentences drawn from the site's stories.
- [Egyptian Arabic Vocabulary by Topic](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/egyptian-arabic/vocabulary): Frequency-ranked Egyptian Arabic word lists grouped by topic — numbers, food and drink, family, colors, time, the body and more — each word with tashkeel, transliteration, the franco spelling used in text messages, and real example sentences. Every list ends with a free practice round mixing multiple choice and speaking out loud.
- [Egyptian Arabic Numbers](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/egyptian-arabic/vocabulary/numbers): Counting in Egyptian Arabic from zero to a million, plus the ordinals and fractions, with Arabic script, pronunciation and audio.
- [Egyptian Arabic Pronunciation](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/egyptian-arabic/pronunciation): The six sound changes that separate Egyptian Arabic from Modern Standard Arabic — ج pronounced as a hard g, ق as a glottal stop, ث and ذ losing their "th", the throat letters ع and ح, the emphatic letters, and the b- present-tense prefix — each with examples and audio.
- [Egyptian Arabic for Beginners](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/egyptian-arabic/beginners): A step-by-step order for learning Egyptian Arabic from scratch, from the alphabet through the first hundred words to a first conversation, with the free page that covers each step.

## Feature Guides

- [All features](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/features): Every Parallel Arabic feature, with screenshots.
- [Arabic conversation practice for everyday situations](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/features/arabic-conversation-practice): Practice speaking Arabic in everyday role-plays like ordering food or taking a taxi, in Egyptian, Levantine or MSA, with replies glossed and your grammar corrected.
- [Arabic reading practice with graded stories](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/features/arabic-reading-practice): Improve your Arabic reading with short graded stories in Egyptian, Levantine, Moroccan Darija and Fusha. English and transliteration under every sentence, native-speed audio, and tap-to-translate on every word.
- [Tap any Arabic word to see what it means](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/features/tap-to-translate): Tap any word in an Arabic story to see what it means in that sentence, hear it, compare it across Egyptian, Levantine, Darija and Fusha, and save it to your spaced-repetition deck.
- [A structured Arabic course from A1 to C2](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/features/arabic-course): A structured Arabic course with a clear learning path. Step-by-step lessons from beginner to advanced in Egyptian Arabic, Levantine, Moroccan Darija or Modern Standard Arabic, at your own pace.
- [Spaced repetition for Arabic vocabulary](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/features/arabic-spaced-repetition): Review Arabic vocabulary with spaced repetition. Save words from stories and lessons, rate how well you remembered each one, and let the schedule bring it back at the right time. Four dialects.
- [Arabic pronunciation practice with instant feedback](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/features/arabic-pronunciation-practice): Practice Arabic pronunciation by reading sentences out loud and getting a score back instantly. Pick your dialect, your level from A1 to C2 and the grammar you want to drill.
- [Arabic writing practice](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/features/arabic-writing-practice): Practice writing Arabic with sentences made for your level. Type on a built-in Arabic keyboard, reorder scrambled words or trace letter by letter, in Egyptian, Levantine, Darija or Fusha.
- [Arabic verb conjugation practice](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/features/arabic-verb-conjugation-practice): Practice conjugating Arabic verbs in the past, present and future tense, affirmative and negative. Quizzes and reference tables for Egyptian, Levantine, Moroccan Darija and Modern Standard Arabic.
- [Compare Arabic dialects side by side](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/features/compare-arabic-dialects): Compare any Arabic word or phrase across Egyptian, Levantine, Moroccan Darija and Modern Standard Arabic, with audio and transliteration. Plus side-by-side guides to how each pair of dialects differs.
- [Import your Arabic word lists](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/features/import-arabic-vocabulary): Turn any Arabic vocabulary list into review cards. Upload a CSV or TXT file or paste a list, and the missing translation and transliteration are filled in for you.
- [Track every Arabic word you learn](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/features/arabic-vocabulary-tracker): Keep all your Arabic vocabulary in one searchable table: Arabic, English, transliteration, dialect and review status. Sort by what is due and turn your words into sentences and stories.
- [Practice Arabic spelling, vocabulary and grammar by playing](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/features/learn-arabic-by-playing): Practice Arabic by playing: unscramble words and sentences, spot the odd one out or the grammar mistake, or quiz yourself. In Egyptian, Levantine, Darija and Fusha.

## Comparing the Dialects

- [Egyptian Arabic vs Levantine](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/egyptian-arabic-vs-levantine): Pronunciation, verb prefixes, negation and question words compared, with the same phrases side by side.
- [Egyptian Arabic vs Fusha](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/egyptian-arabic-vs-fusha): How the spoken dialect differs from the written standard, and which to learn first.
- [Egyptian Arabic vs Darija](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/egyptian-arabic-vs-darija): The widest gap between two Arabic dialects, and why Darija is hard for eastern speakers.
- [Levantine vs Fusha](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/levantine-vs-fusha), [Levantine vs Darija](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/levantine-vs-darija), [Darija vs Fusha](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/darija-vs-fusha): The remaining pairings.

## Writing

- [Blog](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/blog): Articles on Arabic pronunciation, the alphabet, and writing Arabic in Latin script.

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/pricing): Free tier plus a $10/month Premium subscription that unlocks all dialects, structured lessons, unlimited AI-generated practice, and full audio content.

## Tools & Add-ons

- [Mobile App](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/mobile-app): Parallel Arabic is on the App Store for iPhone and iPad, free to download. There is no Android app; on Android and desktop the site installs as a Progressive Web App.
- [Anki Decks](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/anki-decks): Pre-built Anki flashcard decks for each supported dialect.
- [Arabic Keyboard](https://www.parallel-arabic.com/keyboard): A custom on-screen Arabic keyboard usable inside the writing and sentence-practice exercises.
